model_evaluation.limitation: Small synthetic English dataset. This does not establish real-world accuracy or multilingual support.

performance.environment: Local in-process WSGI API calls and synthetic SQLite fixtures
performance.limitation: API timings measure local Naive Bayes only; exclude external Gemini latency, network, browser rendering and human response.

steps.check: Student signs in
Student profile shows the SDU address, admission year and current course
AI mode is visibly local and does not claim an Gemini connection
Submit an IT request and see correct department
Unclear request escalates to staff
Routing confirmation and notifications appear
Support signs in and sees pending request
Route directly from queue using department selector and Route button
Start work and resolve with a student-visible explanation
Student sees resolved status and history
15-second status polling preserves a typed request draft
Mobile layout has no horizontal overflow
Administrator adjusts threshold through UI
500-request staff queue renders within three seconds
Registration form rejects non-SDU student addresses
Direct API registration also blocks wrong domains and spoofed suffixes
Public registration cannot create the helpdesk account
Registration previews course from admission year
SDU student can register through the interface and gets a student profile
Student navigating to staff page returns to own portal
Offline sprint board supports filtering, owner edits, status changes and export

browser.scope: Local end-to-end demonstration using synthetic accounts. Timings exclude human response.

external_ai.integration: Implemented and tested with mocked HTTP responses
external_ai.live_provider_test: Not executed: no API key was supplied
external_ai.activation: Run setup_gemini_windows.bat, restart, then python scripts/check_ai.py

university_registration.course_rule: Academic-year start minus admission year plus 1
university_registration.ownership_verification: Not implemented: address-format restriction does not verify control of the mailbox.

ci_status: Configured in .github/workflows/tests.yml; no remote GitHub execution claimed.
human_review: Staffing SLA, Product Owner acceptance, team names and actual ceremonies require real course records.
